title: Decompose decision variance using Sobol sensitivity indices and variance dispersal — assess_decisions
text: function implements Sobol-style decomposition "decision sets" (e.g., filter decisions) treated factors whose combinations produce different specifications. decomposition reveals analytical choices strongest influence results. function computes four complementary variance measures: Main effect (first-order Sobol): much decision matter average, ignoring interactions? Computed averaging estimand combinations decisions, computing variance conditional means. Total effect (total-order Sobol): much variance remains fix decisions except one? Includes decision's main effect plus interactions involving . Interaction effect: gap total main effects, showing much decision's impact depends choices. Variance reduction: much total variance decrease picked one option decision? Useful prioritizing decisions "fix" reduce result instability. Interpretation: decision high main effect drives results independently. decision high interaction effect matters, differently depending choices. decision low total effect relatively inconsequential.
